title: AUTOCARE GOLDEN B PILOT — SIX KSB SHADOW REVIEW

designPrinciple.statement: A KSB can be structurally mapped correctly while still having teaching-depth, practice, assessment, or evidence-visibility weaknesses. A KSB can be substantively taught while having no correct structural Primary. Programme health must not be reduced to one mapped/unmapped flag.
designPrinciple.visibilityRule: Do not treat a document that has not been supplied as proof that teaching, practice or assessment does not exist.

S9.interpretation: S9 is no longer defensibly described as a simple curriculum-teaching gap. Live curriculum teaches removal/dismount, repair, replacement/refitting and balancing. Residual issues are assessed practical visibility and final Primary ownership.

deferredNextStep.whenReady: Open another limited, deliberately patterned human-reviewed shadow tranche (not easiest KSBs only). Continue full live corpus and taxonomy validation.

futureProductRequirementRecordOnly.summary: After Autocare validation, Programme Builder should onboard other standards using the same evidence categories; longer term become curriculum-authoring source generating standardised GTA documents traceable OFFICIAL→KSB→BLOCK→SESSION→TEACHING→PRACTICE→ASSESSMENT→EVIDENCE.
